title: David Lockwood Jr. and Evan Holyfield v. Central Carolina Presbytery
disposition_detail: Item 4 sustained in part; Items 1, 2, 3, and 5 not sustained.
first_summary: David Lockwood Jr. and Evan Holyfield challenged Central Carolina Presbytery's commission for allegedly failing to act and mishandling discipline and reconciliation at New Life Presbyterian Church. The General Assembly commission rejected the failure-to-act claims, citing twenty-three meetings, and found that the complainants had not followed the reconciliation plan; it nevertheless sustained one overlapping membership-discipline item in part by reference to its ruling in Case 6.
